0022600098.text: The Detroit Pistons (1-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) are on the road for their second game of the 2026-27 season after a home win to start the year. Miami has not played a 2026-27 game yet, and the 2026-27 season series has no games so far, while the Pistons lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 121-110 loss in Miami on March 8, 2026. Taurean Prince is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision for Detroit.
